high_level_description: The image is a slide from a presentation with a black background and white text. The title of the slide is "6. Philosophical View: Reflection, Not Perception." Below the title, there is a paragraph of text that discusses the nature of attention maps in AI. The text reads: "An attention map doesn’t see — it reflects structured regularities in language. It’s the mirror of reality as recorded in human text, not the world itself. Thus, AI’s “reality” is: Indirect — derived from our linguistic and cultural traces. Non-embodied — it doesn’t have sensory correction loops.
